company.name: SpaceRyde
company.shortDescription: SpaceRyde uses balloons to launch micro and nano satellites to space, faster and cheaper than anyone else.
company.description: SpaceRyde (fka Loonify Space) is the taxi to space, for small satellites. A balloon takes a high-performing ultra-light rocket to the edge of the atmosphere, where the rocket is fired to take satellites to Low Earth Orbit.
